title: CASP17 Structure Atlas
description: Five NESG/BMRB CASP17 NMR conformational ensemble targets (SR215 with deterministic 3-tier RPF integration, CmR116, PaT90, StR82, BhR2).

residue_scopes: res32-47-plus78-99-plus121-139 (A:32-47 + A:78-99 + A:121-139, 57 aa; AFsample3+BioEmu2 cohort)
staged_targets.notes: 10 model x residue cohorts (20 views) with 12,432 packed C-alpha structures and deterministic 3-tier RPF integration: Tier 1 per-model RPF DP/Recall/Precision (SR215-TR-2026-11-13-v3, 12,104 models) + MolProbity + ProteinEBM M6; Tier 2 per-residue sr215_DP.QP NOESY precision diagnostics (SR215-TR-2026-11-06-v1 archived, split into single-model sharded and joint-ensemble Model ave); Tier 3 exact ensemble RPF (SR215-TR-2026-11-06-v1 archived, 48 AIS panels + 6 no-AFCluster state panels); validated atlas-score-bundle-v1 CSVs and PDF reports.
